topics.concept: Vector similarity search finds the stored vectors closest to a query vector, which powers semantic search over text, images, and recommendations. Cosine similarity measures the angle between vectors, ignoring magnitude. The simulator shows how ranking quality changes with vector dimension and noise.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded vectors with known nearest neighbors and measures recall of brute-force search.
topics.name: Vector Similarity Search
topics.real_world_use: Semantic search and recommendation engines rank items by vector closeness.

topics.concept: A cosine similarity engine computes pairwise cosine scores between query and document vectors with proper L2 normalization. Batch computation keeps scoring fast as the corpus grows. The engine reports score distributions so threshold tuning is data-driven.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded normalized vectors and verifies scores match expected cosine values.
topics.name: Cosine Similarity Engine
topics.real_world_use: Text matching and duplicate detection use cosine scores as the core signal.

topics.concept: An embedding store supports create, read, update, and delete operations on vectors plus their metadata payloads. Upserts handle re-embedding without duplicates, and deletes respect tombstone policies. The simulation verifies consistency after mixed operation sequences.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded CRUD operation sequences and verifies store state matches expectations.
topics.name: Embedding Store CRUD
topics.real_world_use: Vector-backed applications manage embeddings like a database table.

topics.concept: A similarity metric comparer benchmarks cosine, dot product, and Euclidean distance on the same retrieval task. Metric choice interacts with normalization: dot product equals cosine only on normalized vectors. The report shows which metric wins per data distribution.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded vector distributions and compares retrieval recall per metric.
topics.name: Similarity Metric Comparer
topics.real_world_use: Search engineers pick the scoring function that fits their embedding model.

topics.concept: A nearest-neighbor visualizer projects high-dimensional vectors to two dimensions and plots queries with their retrieved neighbors. Cluster structure becomes visible, revealing whether similar items group together. The simulation uses seeded clusters with known membership.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded clustered vectors and checks that visualization preserves cluster structure.
topics.name: Nearest Neighbor Visualizer
topics.real_world_use: Data scientists inspect embedding quality and cluster structure visually.

topics.concept: Filtered vector search applies metadata filters before or during similarity ranking, so results respect constraints like category or date range. Pre-filtering is exact but can starve the result set; post-filtering is approximate but flexible. The simulation compares both on selective filters.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded vectors with metadata and compares pre-filter versus post-filter recall.
topics.name: Filtered Vector Search
topics.real_world_use: Catalog search restricts semantic results to in-stock or in-category items.

topics.concept: Batch vector ingest loads large embedding sets efficiently with chunked writes, progress tracking, and retry on partial failures. Throughput tuning balances batch size against memory limits. The simulation measures ingest rate and verifies no vectors are lost.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded embedding batches with injected write failures and verifies completeness after retries.
topics.name: Batch Vector Ingest
topics.real_world_use: Search platforms bulk-load millions of embeddings during indexing jobs.

topics.concept: A vector schema validator checks that every stored vector matches the declared dimension, dtype, and metadata schema. Schema drift detection catches embedding-model changes that would corrupt the index. Validation runs on ingest and on scheduled audits.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded vectors with planted schema violations and measures detection rate.
topics.name: Vector Schema Validator
topics.real_world_use: Production vector stores guard against corrupted or mismatched embeddings.

topics.concept: Approximate nearest neighbor indexing trades a little recall for much faster search on large corpora. The simulator implements a simple ANN structure and measures the recall-latency curve as parameters change. This makes the speed-accuracy trade-off concrete before choosing a production index.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded corpora and plots recall versus query latency across index parameter settings.
topics.name: ANN Index Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Large-scale search systems use ANN to serve millions of vectors in milliseconds.

topics.concept: An inverted-file index clusters vectors and searches only the most promising clusters at query time. The number of clusters and the number probed per query control the recall-speed trade-off. The simulator visualizes how cluster count affects both build time and query quality.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded clustered vectors and sweeps cluster counts to map the trade-off curve.
topics.name: IVF Index Simulator
topics.real_world_use: Billion-scale vector search partitions data with inverted-file indexes.

topics.concept: Product quantization compresses vectors by splitting them into subvectors and replacing each with a learned code, shrinking memory by an order of magnitude. The lab measures recall loss at different compression levels. Residual refinement shows how accuracy can be partially recovered.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded vectors and measures recall versus compression ratio across codebook sizes.
topics.name: Product Quantization Lab
topics.real_world_use: Memory-constrained deployments compress huge embedding indexes.

topics.concept: A dense-sparse hybrid index stores both dense embeddings and sparse keyword vectors, combining them at query time. Alpha weighting balances semantic and lexical signals per query type. The simulation shows hybrids winning on queries with rare exact terms.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded queries with rare terms and compares hybrid versus dense-only recall.
topics.name: Dense-Sparse Hybrid Index
topics.real_world_use: Enterprise search blends semantic and keyword signals for robust ranking.

topics.concept: An embedding cache layer sits in front of the embedding service, keyed by text hash, so repeated texts skip recomputation. TTL and size limits bound staleness and memory. The simulation measures hit rates on realistic request streams with duplicates.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded request streams with duplicate texts and reports cache hit rate and time saved.
topics.name: Embedding Cache Layer
topics.real_world_use: High-volume indexing pipelines cache embeddings to cut compute costs.

topics.concept: A vector index benchmark measures queries per second, recall, and build time across index configurations on the same dataset. Standardized workloads make configurations comparable. The report recommends a configuration per latency budget.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded benchmark workloads and ranks index configurations by latency and recall.
topics.name: Vector Index Benchmark
topics.real_world_use: Infrastructure teams pick index settings backed by benchmark data.

topics.concept: An approximate recall tester estimates true recall of an ANN index by comparing against brute-force ground truth on a sample of queries. Sampling strategy balances measurement cost against estimate confidence. The tester reports recall with confidence intervals.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded corpora and validates that sampled recall estimates match full recall.
topics.name: Approximate Recall Tester
topics.real_world_use: Search quality teams monitor ANN index accuracy in production.

topics.concept: A dimensionality reducer compresses embeddings with techniques like PCA or random projection to speed up search and cut storage. The lab measures how much recall survives at each reduced dimension. Elbow analysis finds the dimension where quality starts to drop.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded high-dimensional vectors and plots recall versus reduced dimension.
topics.name: Dimensionality Reducer
topics.real_world_use: Teams shrink embeddings to fit latency and storage budgets.

topics.concept: HNSW builds a multi-layer graph where each layer is a navigable small-world network, giving logarithmic search time. The explorer visualizes layer structure and greedy search paths on a seeded graph. Parameters ef and M trade construction cost against recall.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded graphs with known structure and measures search hops versus recall.
topics.name: HNSW Graph Explorer
topics.real_world_use: Production vector databases use HNSW as their default ANN index.

topics.concept: An embedding drift monitor watches for shifts in the distribution of stored vectors that signal a changed embedding model or data source. Statistical tests compare recent batches against a baseline. Alerts fire before drift silently degrades search quality.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded vector streams with injected drift and measures detection latency.
topics.name: Embedding Drift Monitor
topics.real_world_use: ML platforms detect model or data changes that would corrupt search.

topics.concept: A vector backup tool snapshots the index and metadata to durable storage with incremental deltas between snapshots. Restore drills verify that a backup actually rebuilds a working index. Retention policies balance recovery granularity against storage cost.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded index mutations and verifies restore correctness from incremental backups.
topics.name: Vector Backup Tool
topics.real_world_use: Production search services back up indexes for disaster recovery.

topics.concept: A shard manager distributes vectors across shards by hash or range partitioning and routes queries to the right shards. Rebalancing moves data when shards grow unevenly. The simulation measures query fan-out and load balance under skewed data.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded skewed vector distributions and measures shard balance and query fan-out.
topics.name: Shard Manager Sim
topics.real_world_use: Distributed vector databases scale horizontally with sharding.

topics.concept: A replica sync simulator keeps read replicas consistent with the primary through async replication with bounded lag. Conflict policies handle concurrent writes during partitions. The simulation measures staleness windows under write load.
topics.data_idea: Simulates seeded write loads with network delays and measures replica lag distribution.
topics.name: Replica Sync Simulator
topics.real_world_use: High-availability vector services replicate indexes across regions.

topics.concept: A query latency profiler breaks vector search time into stages: filter, candidate generation, scoring, and rerank. P99 latency matters more than the average for user-facing search. The profiler attributes slowdowns to specific stages and index settings.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded query workloads with injected slow stages and checks attribution accuracy.
topics.name: Query Latency Profiler
topics.real_world_use: Search engineers diagnose tail latency in production vector queries.

topics.concept: A vector namespace manager isolates tenants or projects into separate namespaces sharing one cluster. Per-namespace quotas bound storage and query load. Access control ensures queries never leak vectors across namespaces.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded multi-tenant vector sets and verifies isolation and quota enforcement.
topics.name: Vector Namespace Manager
topics.real_world_use: SaaS vector platforms isolate customer data with namespaces.

topics.concept: Vector deletion with tombstones marks vectors as deleted without immediately rebuilding the index, which keeps deletes fast. Compaction later reclaims the space during off-peak windows. The simulation tracks query correctness with live tombstones present.
topics.data_idea: Generates seeded delete-heavy workloads and verifies deleted vectors never appear in results.
topics.name: Vector Deletion Tombstones
topics.real_world_use: Vector databases support fast deletes without full index rebuilds.
